d:
Congress’s Abhijeet Wanjari has retained the Nagpur Graduates’ MLC seat, defeating BJP’s Sudhakar Kohale by 3,271 votes. Wanjari secured 67,231 votes after a tense, 40-hour-plus counting process. The result is significant as Nagpur is the home turf of Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis and Union Minister Nitin Gadkari.
